name: review-beta
description: Adversarial multi-aspect review. One entry skill routes any review request — docs, code, agent configuration, CI, front-end, mobile, whole-repo — to the aspect skills that apply, runs each in an isolated fork behind its own tool probe, and synthesizes one de-duplicated, verified report. Requires Claude Code v2.1.218 or later (the aspect skills rely on `background: false`).
